final: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A3 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.A3), total_stats AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, AVG(CAST(count AS REAL)) as avg_count FROM region_counts), filtered_regions AS (SELECT rc.count, CAST(rc.count AS REAL) / ts.total_count as proportion, CAST(rc.count AS REAL) - ts.avg_count as diff FROM region_counts rc CROSS JOIN total_stats ts WHERE rc.count > ts.avg_count) SELECT SUM(count) as total_counts, AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion, AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM filtered_regions
